checked: Read-only reporting preflight and both table writers leave root lifecycle bytes unchanged and do not generate or refit sources.
The raw provenance must already contain the exact reporting dependency set; missing reporting dependencies reject before derived outputs.
Only complete clean raw or complete zero-error postprocessing-review states may write. Incomplete, audited and completed states cannot create or recreate tables.
The reporting stage owns the nonblocking root execution lock and retains original postprocessing-review status and error fields.
An undeclared partial standard table or epsilon CSV is adopted only through immutable exact-byte equality; different prior evidence is never overwritten.
A declared standard table that is missing or changed cannot be regenerated silently. Its manifest requires exactly the six standard CSVs plus the failed-fit gzip, with valid row counts and hashes.
Followup runs reject epsilon CSV or manifest artifacts before writing.
The epsilon manifest binds exact run/design identity, canonical resolved-design bytes, source policy, all actual cell-manifest bytes and every actual partition digest/range/count.
The epsilon output retains exactly 71 columns and the full 72 comparison keys; manifest input hash, source policy, directions, table columns and declared file identity are checked before writes.
A valid raw partition and matching cell-manifest change, while root bytes remain unchanged, is detected after the standard stage and blocks epsilon table/manifest commit.
Injected external root drift preserves the observed root and adjacent expected/observed incident evidence. Restoring old root bytes does not bypass the incident block on retry.
All previously written raw and derived evidence remains intact when an immutable-write or consistency check fails.

combined_test_log.skips: Three explicitly floor-only arithmetic reference cases skip the followup fixture; corresponding floor cases execute.
combined_test_log.warnings: Two pandas FutureWarnings originate in the unchanged historical standard writer when concatenating the all-invalid followup fixture.

independent_test_execution.fixture_boundary: Actual reviewed raw execution/storage with source_records replaced by typed literal records. Both OuSampleSource.sample and PairedFloorSource.sample raise if called. Reporting reads saved records only.

limitations: The fixtures are literal synthetic records, not OU simulations or scientific findings.
Independent numerical table arithmetic and failure-denominator checks are recorded in the separate mathematical reporting review.
This module does not perform the future full raw-array replay, independent artifact audit, plotting, visual review or completed-week seal.
Stage-boundary checks are bounded observations under an advisory lock; they do not provide atomic exclusion against all noncooperating writers or establish the cause of historical runtime incidents.
The mutating writer intentionally rejects closed archives; no separate general closed-archive verification API is introduced in this module.
